sources.snippet: Overview Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4 is a quantized version of Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 31B instruction-tuned multimodal model, optimized by nvidia using NVIDIA Model Optimizer v0.42. with NVFP4 quantization.
